numeric_contract_findings: Exact signed int64, integral decimal/exponent and string/numeric distinction are addressed by PR core conversion; upstream tests omit several required boundaries (2^53-1 and 2^53+2) and rejection variants, so root ID fixtures must supplement.

A fixed numeric-lexeme length budget before Int64/ParseFloat/big.Rat is required; document 1024 bytes if selected, test at limit and limit+1 including zero/extreme exponent and balanced long mantissa/exponent.
Legacy MakeID(float64) path still truncates fractional and cannot recover already rounded inputs; do not claim arbitrary caller float64 correction. Raw clients must use json.Number.

CancelledParams.RequestID becomes json.Number; metadata stays float64 as before. Missing requestId on reused CancelledParams receiver should be explicitly considered/tested to avoid stale value reliance.
Invalid numeric rejection framing must be executable, id:null, with bounded error output and no handler dispatch. Raw invalid literal reflected in PR error message is bounded only after lexeme cap.

cancellation_analysis.structural_observation: acceptRequest rejects duplicate active ID; processResult removes incomingByID before sending response; final req.cancel acts on old invocation pointer. No ID-key cleanup after response write is visible in this owner.
cancellation_analysis.required_adversarial_test: Block old response Write, submit new invocation with reused ID after old map removal, finish old Write/cancellation, then cancel new invocation and prove its identity/state survives; adjacent large IDs remain independent.
cancellation_analysis.bridge_telemetry_map: internal/service/bridge.go requests is telemetry bookkeeping only; ID-key deletion there is not cancellation authority and not claimed as cancellation defect.
